name: Changeling
source:
Changeling is a short visual novel about lost souls and acceptance. Created by Faeri Sami as part of their Vtuber persona's 'lore',  it tackles the difficulties of growing up being different, and the magic of finding a community to call your own. Released and played live on their redebut,  now it's freely available for anyone to experience anywhere!

[from [url=https://faerisami.itch.io/changeling]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Changeling》是一部关于迷途灵魂与接纳的短篇视觉小说，由Faeri Sami创作，作为其虚拟主播角色背景故事的一部分。作品探讨了以与众不同的身份成长时遭遇的困难，以及找到属于自己的社群所带来的魔力。本作在其重新出道时发布并直播游玩，如今已免费开放，让任何人都能随时随地体验！

[摘自[url=https://faerisami.itch.io/changeling]itch.io[/url]]
